heading: Monday, September 29, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5 and DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 4.5
items.summary: Anthropic reports that Claude Sonnet 4.5 scores 77.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 61.4% on OSWorld, and says it can stay on multi-step tasks for more than 30 hours. It kept Sonnet 4 pricing ($3/$15) and launched with the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Code updates.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases experimental DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp with sparse attention
items.summary: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, built on V3.1-Terminus, introduces DeepSeek Sparse Attention for cheaper long-context training and inference; DeepSeek reports performance on par with V3.1-Terminus. API prices were cut by more than 50%, and weights, a tech report and GPU kernels were released.
